scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src backend/test backend/prisma/*.ts backend/scripts packages/contracts/src scripts
